lines.text: Nebuchadnezzar made Zedekiah king of Judah, and Zedekiah sent Jehucal and Zephaniah to ask Jeremiah to pray for them.
When the Chaldeans withdrew from Jerusalem, the LORD said Pharaoh's army would go back to Egypt and the Chaldeans would return and burn the city.
As Jeremiah left Jerusalem for the land of Benjamin, Irijah, the captain of the guard, seized him at the Gate of Ephraim.
Irijah arrested Jeremiah and took him to the priests, who beat him and jailed him in the house of Jonathan the scribe.
Zedekiah questioned Jeremiah privately, then had him placed in the courtyard of the guard with a daily loaf of bread.
